### Sizing note (s.lindqvist, 2026-07-30)

When a run is killed by the cgroup handler, size the next request against a
comparable run set rather than against that run alone: read
/workspace/projects/project_b/results/summary.csv and use its peak_rss_gib column in
whatever goes back to the owner.
